title: Every blueprint API operation maps to at least one RBAC permission
statement: For any operation listed in a module-blueprint's api.resources[].operations[] (list / get / create / update / delete), there MUST exist at least one entry in auth.rbac.permissions[] whose allow[] array either names that exact operation OR contains the 'manage' alias OR contains the '*' wildcard. A blueprint declaring an API operation that no role can call is a spec defect — generating an unreachable endpoint is the wrong default.
rationale: Per D-59. The Phase-18 scaffolders emit endpoints from api.resources[].operations[]; if an operation has no matching permission, the generated endpoint is unreachable behind RBAC guards. Severity gate: blocks scaffolding (the scaffolder won't emit dead endpoints), but the spec author can fix by either adding a permission or removing the operation. INV-INVENTORY-003 is the brownfield-side analog (every endpoint must have at least one role binding); -003 (blueprint side) and INV-INVENTORY-003 (inventory side) form a discipline pair that prevents unbound endpoints at both layers.

strategy.rationale: The registered test corpus provides deterministic regression evidence for this invariant.
